test_unique_function: test the _unique function to get unique values from numpy arrays with optional return_inverse and return_counts
test_encode_function: test the _encode function to encode array values to integer indices based on known unique values
test_check_unknown_function: test the _check_unknown function to identify unknown values in data against known uniques with optional mask return
test_get_counts_function: test the _get_counts function to count occurrences of each unique value in an array
test_missing_values_handling: test _unique, _encode, and _check_unknown functions for handling NaN and None missing values in object and numeric dtypes
